stock.title: Stock token
stock.description: The Robinhood stock token whose ballot this is. A Uniswap position counts only if one side of its pool IS this token, and only that side is credited.

decimals.title: Decimals
decimals.description: Stock token decimals. 18 on Robinhood Chain.

rpcUrl.title: Discovery RPC endpoint (optional)
rpcUrl.description: Endpoint the Transfer-log discovery scan reads from. Defaults to https://rpc.mainnet.chain.robinhood.com, which errors at its block-span cap rather than silently truncating a wide eth_getLogs — unlike the Tenderly gateway, which undercounts without erroring. Override only with another endpoint that errors rather than truncates.
